mapper.sql: select ss.id, ss.user_id, ss.shop_id, ss.is_default, ss.role, ss.create_time, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phonenumber, u.status as user_status from staff_shop ss inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = ss.user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where ss.shop_id = #{shopId} order by ss.is_default desc, ss.id asc
select count(1) from staff_shop where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into staff_shop (user_id, shop_id, is_default, role, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{shopId}, #{isDefault}, #{role}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update staff_shop set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1
mapper.delete: delete from staff_shop where shop_id = #{shopId} and user_id = #{userId}
